description: This file provides utilities for retrieving and validating the user's shell environment, including platform-specific configurations, environment variables, and an allowlist for security.

methods.name: getWindowsTerminalConfig
methods.description: Retrieves Windows terminal configuration from VS Code settings.

methods.name: getMacTerminalConfig
methods.description: Retrieves macOS terminal configuration from VS Code settings.

methods.name: getLinuxTerminalConfig
methods.description: Retrieves Linux terminal configuration from VS Code settings.

methods.name: normalizeShellPath
methods.description: Normalizes a shell path that can be a string or array of strings.

methods.name: getWindowsShellFromVSCode
methods.description: Determines the shell path for Windows based on VS Code configuration.

methods.name: getMacShellFromVSCode
methods.description: Determines the shell path for macOS based on VS Code configuration.

methods.name: getLinuxShellFromVSCode
methods.description: Determines the shell path for Linux based on VS Code configuration.

methods.name: getShellFromUserInfo
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the user's shell from system user info.

methods.name: getShellFromEnv
methods.description: Retrieves the shell environment variable based on platform.

methods.name: isShellAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a shell path is in the allowlist for security.

methods.name: getSafeFallbackShell
methods.description: Provides a default safe shell based on platform.

methods.name: getShell
methods.description: Main function to get the user's shell, checking VS Code config, system info, environment, and fallback.
